art_direction: RoomScale category: settlement_structure. Create two compact lived-in Scavenger cottages on the existing shared 17 x 7 x 9 inch site. Keep each home individually recognizable and make the pair readable at the 64-inch settlement camera. Use repaired drawer boards and pallet timber, one broad faded-blue appliance door and one broad cream appliance door, small reuse-glass windows, and restrained iron straps. Give the two roofs related but different silhouettes: one shallow asymmetric sheet canopy and one short patched lean-to with a canvas repair. Show a shared uneven porch landing and one small household storage form at the outside edge. Use broad material blocks and clear shape differences instead of tiny trim. Include at most one plain capped vent. Avoid gears, boilers, copper trim, brass ornament, or a Clockwork cottage reskin. Preserve all simulation and RoomDefinition data.
